blurb: Erie Basin Marina provides seasonal and transient wet slips, dry slip storage, launch facilities, and on-site fueling. It is located minutes from downtown Buffalo with direct access to Lake Erie and the Erie Canal. The marina also features a convenience store and waterfront dining at Harbor Walk.
